authorization: User requested background colors, dots/grid, required preservation across devices, reviewed the document-settings proposal, then requested background implementation first.

scope.state: One document-level value retained by the existing canonical store owner; no synthetic ObjectRecord, second document, or host-owned semantic state.
scope.value: Version 1: mode plain/dots/grid; opaque RGBA background color; RGBA pattern color. All color components finite in [0,1]; base alpha must be 1. Invalid modes/values reject atomically. Default: plain white, pattern [0.7,0.75,0.8,0.55]. Grid spacing is a fixed 24 world units in v1; zoom-dependent thinning is derived presentation state.
scope.mutation: Append SetDocumentBackground Operation kind/payload tag 19, full replacement, using existing normalization, validation, deduplication, preparation, publication and History. No-op local changes succeed without a new Operation. Same ordered canonical stream yields same final value. No new distributed conflict algorithm.
scope.history: Capture background before/after values before commit; Undo/Redo emit fresh ordinary Operations. A conflicting remote background change rejects local compensation rather than overwriting it.
scope.snapshot: Append DocumentSnapshot field 11. Non-default settings require document-background-v1 plus reader capability bit 32. Legacy snapshots omit background and retain their existing bytes/digests/default white behavior. Include non-default background in semantic and checkpoint digests. Restore before surface binding and reject unsupported readers.
scope.wire: DocumentBackgroundV1 carries version=1, mode, color, pattern_color, with complete field presence. Existing published dependency locks and host protoc are reused; only Axiom-owned schema/code changes.
scope.sdk: Expose readBackground and setBackground DTOs through the existing source facade, shared Session control vocabulary, JS module/TypeScript declarations and caller-side Windows wrapper. No new DLL export or internal owner access. Owner-thread, lifecycle, busy, full target stamp, admission and receipts remain existing controls.
scope.render: Shared renderer draws the background before canonical content and interaction overlays. Pattern follows world origin and camera, with bounded zoom-dependent density. No effect on object count, selection, erasing, z-order or content bounds. Frame plans carry an immutable background value.
scope.demo: Background mode and color controls apply through the public SDK. Draft control values do not mutate canonical state until Apply; reset draft from current committed settings on Cancel. No additional public preview API.

forbidden_changes: dependency lock changes or source dependency rebuilds
editing frozen historical corpora or expected values

required.command_or_oracle: Native semantic/composition tests: defaults, valid modes, invalid/non-finite values, duplicate/collision rejection, canonical generation, publication capacity, Undo/Redo and remote conflict
required.expected_result: All changed behavior passes through actual owners; rejection preserves canonical state and history
required.blocking_reason: Detects document corruption and false commit/publication

required.command_or_oracle: Native roundtrip/bootstrap/digest tests and existing snapshot regressions
required.expected_result: Background survives restore and later edits; legacy bytes remain valid; tampering and unsupported readers reject
required.blocking_reason: Detects lost or silently reinterpreted saved settings

required.command_or_oracle: Real browser consumer against matching built JS/WASM: read/write, pixels for solid/dots/grid, pan/zoom, Snapshot restore, two Runtime Operation transfer, Undo/Redo and malformed calls
required.expected_result: Public SDK behavior and rendered pixels agree without internal object access
required.blocking_reason: Detects bridge and presentation integration failures

required.command_or_oracle: Native configured CTest suite, runtime boundary checker, consumer packaging tests, JS/TS syntax/type checks
required.expected_result: Affected regressions pass; existing unrelated failures reported explicitly; consumer payload remains encapsulated
required.blocking_reason: Detects damage to existing editing and external contracts

all_of: all required behavior implemented and verified
